literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt explicitly asks which headword Merriam-Webster assigns this definition. Its complete blouse entry, sense 2, says “a usually loose-fitting garment especially for women that covers the body from the neck to the waist” (L56-L58). This establishes a unique answer by the named dictionary’s definition, not by assuming the described everyday properties cannot overlap across garments. The other choices are comparable, familiar upper-body garments and are different headwords in their retained complete Merriam-Webster entries.
